collections.disclaimer:
The colors of Miraco HPL products displayed on this website may differ from the actual products due to variations in display devices, screen settings, and lighting conditions. Miraco has made every effort to present colors as accurately as possible. 

 To ensure optimal color accuracy, we recommend contacting Miraco to request a physical sample as a reference before placing an order.

Footer.content: Miraco presents high-quality High Pressure Laminates crafted to meet modern architectural standards. Designed with precision to deliver durability, aesthetics, and long-term value in every space.

key_features.title: Our Features
key_features.description: We combine anti-bacterial protection and anti-fingerprint performance with a refined soft-touch feel, while MIRACORE technology delivers a color-matched core that eliminates harsh joint lines—creating cleaner, more hygienic, and seamlessly elegant surfaces built for modern interiors.

features.title: Anti Bacteria
features.description: Anti-bacterial protection helps inhibit microbial growth on the surface, promoting a cleaner, safer environment for everyday living.

features.title: Anti Fingerprint
features.description: Anti-fingerprint technology reduces visible marks and smudges, keeping surfaces clean, refined, and effortlessly elegant.

features.title: Soft Touch
features.description: Soft-touch finish delivers a smooth, velvety feel that enhances comfort while adding a refined, premium character to the surface.

features.title: MIRACORE
features.description: MIRACORE features a color-matched core that eliminates dark joint lines, creating a seamless, solid, and architecturally refined surface.
